meaning.en: to feel you have looked foolish in front of others (social embarrassment)
meaning.tr: başkalarının önünde küçük düştüğünü hissetmek (sosyal utanç)
meaning.de: das Gefühl haben, vor anderen dumm dagestanden zu haben (soziale Verlegenheit)

equivalent.de: jemandem ist etwas peinlich, verlegen sein

usage.en: embarrassed about/by sth · embarrassed to + verb → the one who feels it. embarrassing → the situation that causes it. embarrass sb → to cause it.
usage.tr: embarrassed about/by sth · embarrassed to + fiil → hisseden. embarrassing → utandıran durum. embarrass sb → sebep olmak.

sentences.en: I was so [embarrassed] when my card got declined.
sentences.tr: Kartım reddedilince çok utandım.
sentences.de: Es war mir so peinlich, als meine Karte abgelehnt wurde.

sentences.en: I'm [embarrassed] to admit I've never read it.
sentences.tr: İtiraf etmeye utanıyorum ama hiç okumadım.
sentences.de: Es ist mir peinlich zuzugeben, dass ich es nie gelesen habe.

sentences.en: Mom, stop, you're [embarrassing] me!
sentences.tr: Anne dur, beni rezil ediyorsun!
sentences.de: Mama, hör auf, du blamierst mich!

meaning.en: to be so embarrassed you want to disappear
meaning.de: sich so schämen, dass man verschwinden möchte

equivalent.de: vor Scham im Boden versinken, jemandem ist etwas todpeinlich

usage.en: be (absolutely) mortified (by sth / when … / to find out). ✗ very mortified.
usage.tr: be (absolutely) mortified (by sth / when … / to find out). ✗ very mortified.

sentences.en: I called my teacher "Mom" in front of the whole class. I was [mortified].
sentences.tr: Bütün sınıfın önünde öğretmenime "anne" dedim. Yerin dibine girdim.
sentences.de: Ich habe meine Lehrerin vor der ganzen Klasse „Mama“ genannt. Es war mir todpeinlich.

sentences.en: She was [mortified] when she realised she'd sent it to the wrong group chat.
sentences.tr: Mesajı yanlış gruba attığını fark edince rezil oldu.
sentences.de: Sie wäre am liebsten im Boden versunken, als sie merkte, dass sie es an den falschen Gruppenchat geschickt hatte.

meaning.en: to be in an odd, uncomfortable social moment where you don't know what to say or do
meaning.tr: ne diyeceğini/yapacağını bilemediğin tuhaf, rahatsız bir sosyal an yaşamak
meaning.de: in einem seltsamen, unangenehmen Moment sein, in dem man nicht weiß, was man sagen oder tun soll

equivalent.tr: tuhaf hissetmek, garip olmak, ortam gerilmek
equivalent.de: sich unwohl fühlen, etwas ist jemandem unangenehm; peinlich, komisch sein

usage.en: feel awkward (about V-ing) · It's/That was awkward. · an awkward silence · make things awkward. Of a person: socially awkward.
usage.tr: feel awkward (about V-ing) · It's/That was awkward. · an awkward silence · make things awkward. Kişi için: socially awkward.

sentences.en: It was so [awkward] — we went for a hug and a handshake at the same time.
sentences.tr: Çok tuhaf oldu, biri sarılmaya biri tokalaşmaya davrandı.
sentences.de: Es war so peinlich – wir wollten uns gleichzeitig umarmen und die Hand geben.

sentences.en: I [feel awkward] asking him for money.
sentences.tr: Ondan para istemek bana garip geliyor.
sentences.de: Es ist mir unangenehm, ihn um Geld zu bitten.

meaning.en: to look ridiculous in front of everyone

equivalent.tr: rezil olmak, kendini gülünç duruma düşürmek
equivalent.de: sich blamieren, sich zum Affen machen

literal.en: to make yourself into a fool

usage.en: make a (complete/total) fool of yourself · make a fool of sb (to make someone else look ridiculous)
usage.tr: make a (complete/total) fool of yourself · make a fool of sb (başkasını rezil etmek)

sentences.en: I had too much to drink and [made a complete fool of myself].
sentences.tr: Fazla içtim ve kendimi rezil ettim.
sentences.de: Ich habe zu viel getrunken und mich komplett zum Affen gemacht.

sentences.en: I don't want to [make a fool of myself] in front of her parents.
sentences.tr: Ailesinin önünde rezil olmak istemiyorum.
sentences.de: Ich will mich nicht vor ihren Eltern blamieren.

meaning.en: to feel (moral) shame about something wrong you did
meaning.tr: yaptığı yanlış bir şeyden (ahlaki olarak) utanç duymak
meaning.de: (moralische) Scham über etwas Falsches empfinden, das man getan hat

usage.en: ashamed of sth/yourself/sb · ashamed to + verb · "You should be ashamed of yourself."
usage.tr: ashamed of sth/yourself/sb · ashamed to + fiil · "You should be ashamed of yourself."

note.en: embarrassed = social, on the surface (you slipped and fell). ashamed = moral, deep (you treated someone badly).
note.tr: embarrassed = sosyal, yüzeysel (ayağın kaydı, düştün). ashamed = ahlaki, derin (birine kötü davrandın).

sentences.en: I'm [ashamed of] how I treated her back then.
sentences.tr: O zamanlar ona davranış şeklimden utanıyorum.
sentences.de: Ich schäme mich dafür, wie ich sie damals behandelt habe.

sentences.en: There's nothing to be [ashamed of] — everybody needs help sometimes.
sentences.tr: Utanacak bir şey yok, herkesin bazen yardıma ihtiyacı olur.
sentences.de: Dafür muss man sich nicht schämen – jeder braucht mal Hilfe.

meaning.en: to squirm at how embarrassing something is (often on someone else's behalf)
meaning.tr: bir şeyin utanç vericiliği karşısında içi kıyılmak (çoğu zaman başkası adına)
meaning.de: sich winden, weil etwas so peinlich ist (oft stellvertretend für andere)

equivalent.tr: içi kıyılmak, başkası adına utanmak, "cringe" olmak

literal.en: to shrink back, to screw up your face

register.en: informal · the adjective use is slang

usage.en: cringe (at sth) · make sb cringe · cringey / (slang) cringe: "That's so cringe."
usage.tr: cringe (at sth) · make sb cringe · cringey / (argo) cringe: "That's so cringe."

sentences.en: I [cringe] every time I read my old posts.
sentences.tr: Eski paylaşımlarımı her okuduğumda içim kıyılıyor.
sentences.de: Ich zucke jedes Mal zusammen, wenn ich meine alten Posts lese.

sentences.en: His speech was so [cringey] I couldn't watch.
sentences.tr: Konuşması o kadar utanç vericiydi ki izleyemedim.
sentences.de: Seine Rede war so zum Fremdschämen, dass ich nicht hinsehen konnte.

expressions.expr: want to crawl into a hole / want the ground to swallow one up

meaning.en: to want to vanish from embarrassment

equivalent.de: am liebsten im Erdboden versinken, sich verkriechen wollen

literal.en: to want to crawl into a hole / to want the ground to swallow you
literal.tr: bir deliğe girmek istemek / yerin kendisini yutmasını istemek

variety.en: crawl into a hole: AmE + BrE · ground to swallow me up: more common in BrE
variety.tr: crawl into a hole: AmE + BrE · ground to swallow me up: BrE'de daha sık

usage.en: Always in past narration: I wanted to … · Equivalent exaggeration: "I wanted to die."
usage.tr: Hep geçmiş anlatıda: I wanted to … · Eşdeğer abartı: "I wanted to die."

sentences.en: When the video started playing out loud, I wanted to [crawl into a hole].
sentences.tr: Video sesli çalmaya başlayınca yer yarılsa içine girecektim.
sentences.de: Als das Video laut losging, hätte ich mich am liebsten verkrochen.

sentences.en: I just wanted [the ground to swallow me up].
sentences.tr: Yer yarılsa da içine girsem dedim.
sentences.de: Ich wäre am liebsten im Erdboden versunken.

expressions.expr: put one's foot in one's mouth / put one's foot in it

meaning.en: to say something that hurts or embarrasses someone without realising
meaning.tr: farkında olmadan birini kıracak/utandıracak bir şey söylemek
meaning.de: etwas sagen, das jemanden verletzt oder in Verlegenheit bringt, ohne es zu merken

literal.en: to put your foot in your mouth

variety.en: foot in one's mouth: AmE · put one's foot in it: BrE
variety.tr: foot in one's mouth: AmE · put one's foot in it: BrE

usage.en: (really) put your foot in your mouth / in it
usage.tr: (really) put your foot in your mouth / in it

sentences.en: I really [put my foot in my mouth] when I asked about her husband — they just got divorced.
sentences.tr: Kocasını sorunca fena pot kırdım, yeni boşanmışlar.
sentences.de: Ich bin voll ins Fettnäpfchen getreten, als ich nach ihrem Mann fragte – sie sind frisch geschieden.

sentences.en: I think I [put my foot in it] — I didn't know it was a surprise party.
sentences.tr: Galiba pot kırdım, sürpriz parti olduğunu bilmiyordum.
sentences.de: Ich glaube, ich bin ins Fettnäpfchen getreten – ich wusste nicht, dass es eine Überraschungsparty ist.

meaning.en: to have an uneasy conscience about something you did
meaning.tr: yaptığı bir şeyden dolayı vicdanı rahatsız olmak
meaning.de: wegen etwas, das man getan hat, ein schlechtes Gewissen haben

equivalent.tr: kendini kötü hissetmek, vicdan azabı duymak, içi rahat etmemek
equivalent.de: ein schlechtes Gewissen haben, sich schuldig fühlen

usage.en: feel bad about sth/V-ing (for what you did) · feel bad for sb (to feel sorry for someone) · feel guilty about/for V-ing
usage.tr: feel bad about sth/V-ing (yaptığın şey için) · feel bad for sb (birine acımak, üzülmek) · feel guilty about/for V-ing

sentences.en: I [feel bad about] cancelling on her at the last minute.
sentences.tr: Son dakikada onu ektiğim için kendimi kötü hissediyorum.
sentences.de: Ich habe ein schlechtes Gewissen, weil ich ihr in letzter Minute abgesagt habe.

sentences.en: I [feel guilty] for not calling my grandma more often.
sentences.tr: Babaannemi daha sık aramadığım için vicdan azabı çekiyorum.
sentences.de: Ich fühle mich schuldig, weil ich meine Oma nicht öfter anrufe.

meaning.en: to worry so much about how others see you that you can't relax
meaning.tr: başkalarının kendisini nasıl gördüğünü fazla dert edip rahat olamamak
meaning.de: sich so viele Gedanken darüber machen, wie andere einen sehen, dass man nicht locker sein kann

equivalent.de: gehemmt sein, unsicher sein, sich für etwas genieren

usage.en: be/feel/get self-conscious (about sth). Don't confuse with: self-confident — the exact opposite.
usage.tr: be/feel/get self-conscious (about sth). Karıştırma: self-confident (özgüvenli) tam tersi.

sentences.en: I'm really [self-conscious about] my accent.
sentences.tr: Aksanım konusunda çok çekiniyorum.
sentences.de: Ich bin wegen meines Akzents wirklich gehemmt.

sentences.en: He gets [self-conscious] when people watch him eat.
sentences.tr: İnsanlar onu yemek yerken izleyince rahatsız oluyor.
sentences.de: Er wird unsicher, wenn ihm Leute beim Essen zusehen.

meaning.en: an embarrassing event that will never be forgotten
meaning.tr: utanç verici bir olayın asla unutulmayacak olması
meaning.de: ein peinliches Ereignis, das nie vergessen wird

equivalent.tr: bunu ömür boyu başıma kakarlar; asla unutturmazlar
equivalent.de: das wird man jemandem ewig vorhalten; das hängt jemandem ewig nach

literal.en: to be unable to "live it down"

usage.en: Almost always negative/future: I'll never live it/this down.
usage.tr: Neredeyse hep olumsuz/gelecek: I'll never live it/this down.

sentences.en: I fell asleep in the meeting — I'm never going to [live it down].
sentences.tr: Toplantıda uyuyakaldım, bunu bana asla unutturmayacaklar.
sentences.de: Ich bin im Meeting eingeschlafen – das werde ich mir ewig anhören müssen.

sentences.en: If my brother finds out, I'll never [live it down].
sentences.tr: Abim öğrenirse ömür boyu dilinden kurtulamam.
sentences.de: Wenn mein Bruder das erfährt, wird er es mir ewig vorhalten.
